text: Post-audit final local gate is green: bash acceptance harness syntax, formatting, 127 tests on Scala 3.3.8, 127 tests on Scala 3.8.4, and worker packageBin on both versions. Official SchedMD 25.05.6 v0.0.43 source was inspected: fixtures/parser now handle {set,infinite,number} no-value IDs plus bounded matching of compressed array_task_string. Non-array canonical agent JSON omits the new optional field, preserving prior persisted request bytes. P5 remains open solely for captured actual-binary/two-family evidence and authenticated real-site smoke; Trillium authentication is the recorded blocker.
